verdict.rationale: Morph is fundamentally API-first — nearly all documented functionality (chat completions, Fast Apply, Compact, Reflexes, batch, dedicated endpoints, MCP) is exposed via the API/SDK per morph-docs-1 through morph-docs-16, and a playground/dashboard UI is only mentioned in passing (morph-comm-2). There's no explicit documentation enumerating dashboard-only features (billing, endpoint provisioning UI, playground testing) and confirming each has an API equivalent, so full parity isn't demonstrated. Missing for 10: explicit UI/dashboard feature list mapped to API endpoints, confirmation that account/billing/endpoint-management actions available in the dashboard are also API-accessible, and independent verification of parity.
